, E.PRE_FIXED_OT_STR_TIME , E.PRE_FIXED_OT_END_TIME , E.FIXED_OT_STR_TIME , E.FIXED_OT_END_TIME FROM (
SELECT M.CMPNY_CD, M.SITE_CD, M.SCH_CD, M.APPLY_DATE , M.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, M.FST_SCH_END_TIME, M.FST_SCH_BRK_MIN , M.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME, M.SEC_SCH_END_TIME, M.SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN , M.PRE_FIXED_OT_STR_TIME, M.PRE_FIXED_OT_END_TIME , M.FIXED_OT_STR_TIME, M.FIXED_OT_END_TIME , 2147483647 AS HIST_IDX FROM TB_SCH_MGMT M WHERE M.CMPNY_CD = #{prvCmpnyCd} AND M.SITE_CD = #{targetSiteCd} UNION ALL SELECT H.CMPNY_CD, H.SITE_CD, H.SCH_CD, H.APPLY_DATE , H.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, H.FST_SCH_END_TIME, H.FST_SCH_BRK_MIN , H.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME, H.SEC_SCH_END_TIME, H.SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN , H.PRE_FIXED_OT_STR_TIME, H.PRE_FIXED_OT_END_TIME , H.FIXED_OT_STR_TIME, H.FIXED_OT_END_TIME , H.HIST_IDX FROM TB_SCH_MGMT_HIST H WHERE H.CMPNY_CD = #{prvCmpnyCd} AND H.SITE_CD = #{targetSiteCd} ) E LEFT JOIN TB_SCH_MGMT MT ON MT.CMPNY_CD = E.CMPNY_CD AND MT.SITE_CD = E.SITE_CD AND MT.SCH_CD = E.SCH_CD WHERE E.HIST_IDX = ( SELECT MAX(E2.HIST_IDX) FROM ( SELECT M2.CMPNY_CD, M2.SITE_CD, M2.SCH_CD, M2.APPLY_DATE, 2147483647 AS HIST_IDX FROM TB_SCH_MGMT M2 WHERE M2.CMPNY_CD = #{prvCmpnyCd} AND M2.SITE_CD = #{targetSiteCd} UNION ALL SELECT H2.CMPNY_CD, H2.SITE_CD, H2.SCH_CD, H2.APPLY_DATE, H2.HIST_IDX FROM TB_SCH_MGMT_HIST H2 WHERE H2.CMPNY_CD = #{prvCmpnyCd} AND H2.SITE_CD = #{targetSiteCd} ) E2 WHERE E2.CMPNY_CD = E.CMPNY_CD AND E2.SITE_CD = E.SITE_CD AND E2.SCH_CD = E.SCH_CD AND E2.APPLY_DATE = E.APPLY_DATE )

/* Subcon03Mapper.selectAttdSourceRows */ SELECT A.USER_CD AS userCd , CASE WHEN U.USER_CD IS NOT NULL THEN 'REGULAR' ELSE 'DAILY' END AS workerType , COALESCE(U.USER_NM, D.USER_NM) AS workerNm , 'ATTD' AS rowType , A.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , A.WORK_SEQ AS workSeq , SCH.SCH_NO AS schNm , SCH.SCH_TYPE AS schType , CASE WHEN A.WORK_SEQ = 2 THEN SCH.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME ELSE SCH.FST_SCH_STR_TIME END AS planStrTime , CASE WHEN A.WORK_SEQ = 2 THEN SCH.SEC_SCH_END_TIME ELSE SCH.FST_SCH_END_TIME END AS planEndTime , CASE WHEN A.WORK_SEQ = 2 THEN SCH.SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN ELSE SCH.FST_SCH_BRK_MIN END AS planBrkMin , A.CHECK_IN_DATE AS checkInDate , A.CHECK_IN_TIME AS checkInTime , A.CHECK_OUT_DATE AS checkOutDate , A.CHECK_OUT_TIME AS checkOutTime , CASE WHEN A.CHECK_IN_TIME IS NULL OR A.CHECK_IN_TIME = '' THEN 'ABSENT' /* 지각: 실제 출근 일시 > 스케줄 시작 일시(시작은 근무일 당일) */ WHEN A.WORK_SEQ = 1 AND SCH.FST_SCH_STR_TIME IS NOT NULL AND CONCAT(IFNULL(A.CHECK_IN_DATE, A.WORK_YMD), A.CHECK_IN_TIME) > CONCAT(A.WORK_YMD, SCH.FST_SCH_STR_TIME) THEN 'LATE' WHEN A.WORK_SEQ = 2 AND SCH.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME IS NOT NULL AND CONCAT(IFNULL(A.CHECK_IN_DATE, A.WORK_YMD), A.CHECK_IN_TIME) > CONCAT(A.WORK_YMD, SCH.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME) THEN 'LATE' /* 조퇴: 실제 퇴근 일시가 스케줄 종료 일시보다 이르면 조퇴(야간이면 종료는 근무일 익일). ※ 주석 안에도 부등호(<) 문자를 쓰지 말 것 — XML 파서가 태그 시작으로 읽어 매퍼 로딩이 깨진다. */ WHEN A.WORK_SEQ = 1 AND SCH.FST_SCH_END_TIME IS NOT NULL AND A.CHECK_OUT_TIME IS NOT NULL AND A.CHECK_OUT_TIME != '' AND CONCAT(IFNULL(A.CHECK_OUT_DATE, A.WORK_YMD), A.CHECK_OUT_TIME) < CONCAT( CASE WHEN SCH.FST_SCH_STR_TIME IS NOT NULL AND SCH.FST_SCH_END_TIME < SCH.FST_SCH_STR_TIME THEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(A.WORK_YMD, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y%m%d') ELSE A.WORK_YMD END , SCH.FST_SCH_END_TIME) THEN 'EARLY_LEAVE' WHEN A.WORK_SEQ = 2 AND SCH.SEC_SCH_END_TIME IS NOT NULL AND A.CHECK_OUT_TIME IS NOT NULL AND A.CHECK_OUT_TIME != '' AND CONCAT(IFNULL(A.CHECK_OUT_DATE, A.WORK_YMD), A.CHECK_OUT_TIME) < CONCAT( CASE WHEN SCH.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME IS NOT NULL AND SCH.SEC_SCH_END_TIME < SCH.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME THEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(A.WORK_YMD, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y%m%d') ELSE A.WORK_YMD END , SCH.SEC_SCH_END_TIME) THEN 'EARLY_LEAVE' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS attdStatusCd , IFNULL(OT.otMinutes, 0) AS otMinutes , LV.leaveNm AS leaveNm , LV.leaveDays AS leaveDays , LV.leaveMinutes AS leaveMinutes , NULL AS leaveEndYmd
, A.NODE_CD AS nodeCd FROM TB_USER_ATTD_MGMT A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = A.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_DAILY_USER D ON D.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND D.USER_CD = A.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_USER_WORK_PLAN WP ON WP.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND WP.SITE_CD = A.SITE_CD AND WP.USER_CD = A.USER_CD AND WP.WORK_YMD = A.WORK_YMD LEFT OUTER JOIN (
) SCH ON SCH.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND SCH.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND SCH.SCH_CD = WP.WORK_PLAN_CD AND SCH.APPLY_DATE = ( SELECT COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SE.APPLY_DATE <= WP.WORK_YMD THEN SE.APPLY_DATE END) , MIN(SE.APPLY_DATE) ) FROM ( SELECT M3.CMPNY_CD, M3.SITE_CD, M3.SCH_CD, M3.APPLY_DATE FROM TB_SCH_MGMT M3 UNION ALL SELECT H3.CMPNY_CD, H3.SITE_CD, H3.SCH_CD, H3.APPLY_DATE FROM TB_SCH_MGMT_HIST H3 ) SE WHERE SE.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND SE.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND SE.SCH_CD = WP.WORK_PLAN_CD )
LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT O.USER_CD AS USER_CD , O.WORK_YMD AS WORK_YMD , SUM(IFNULL(O.WORK_MINUTES, 0)) AS otMinutes FROM TB_USER_OVERTIME_MGMT O WHERE O.CMPNY_CD = #{prvCmpnyCd} AND O.SITE_CD = #{targetSiteCd} AND O.WORK_YMD BETWEEN #{periodStr} AND #{periodEnd} AND O.DEL_YN = 'N' AND O.OT_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY O.USER_CD, O.WORK_YMD ) OT ON OT.USER_CD = A.USER_CD AND OT.WORK_YMD = A.WORK_YMD
AND A.ATTD_ID = ( SELECT A2.ATTD_ID FROM TB_USER_ATTD_MGMT A2 WHERE A2.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND A2.SITE_CD = A.SITE_CD AND A2.USER_CD = A.USER_CD AND A2.WORK_YMD = A.WORK_YMD AND A2.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY A2.WORK_SEQ ASC, A2.ATTD_ID ASC LIMIT 1 )
LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT L.USER_CD AS USER_CD , L.START_DATE AS START_DATE , LEFT(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT T.LEAVE_NM ORDER BY T.LEAVE_NM SEPARATOR ','), 200) AS leaveNm , SUM(IFNULL(L.LEAVE_DAYS, 0)) AS leaveDays , SUM(IFNULL(L.LEAVE_MINUTES, 0)) AS leaveMinutes FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE L LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_LEAVE_TYPE_MGMT T ON T.CMPNY_CD = L.CMPNY_CD AND T.LEAVE_CD = L.LEAVE_CD WHERE L.CMPNY_CD = #{prvCmpnyCd} AND L.SITE_CD = #{targetSiteCd} AND L.START_DATE BETWEEN #{periodStr} AND #{periodEnd} AND L.DEL_YN = 'N' AND L.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' GROUP BY L.USER_CD, L.START_DATE ) LV ON LV.USER_CD = A.USER_CD AND LV.START_DATE = A.WORK_YMD
AND A.ATTD_ID = ( SELECT A3.ATTD_ID FROM TB_USER_ATTD_MGMT A3 WHERE A3.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND A3.SITE_CD = A.SITE_CD AND A3.USER_CD = A.USER_CD AND A3.WORK_YMD = A.WORK_YMD AND A3.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY A3.WORK_SEQ ASC, A3.ATTD_ID ASC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{prvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{targetSiteCd} AND A.WORK_YMD BETWEEN #{periodStr} AND #{periodEnd} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY A.USER_CD ASC, A.WORK_YMD ASC, A.WORK_SEQ ASC

/* Subcon03Mapper.selectFixedOtScheduleRows */ SELECT WP.USER_CD AS userCd , WP.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , SCH.FST_SCH_STR_TIME AS fstSchStrTime , SCH.FST_SCH_END_TIME AS fstSchEndTime , SCH.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME AS secSchStrTime , SCH.SEC_SCH_END_TIME AS secSchEndTime , SCH.PRE_FIXED_OT_STR_TIME AS preFixedOtStrTime , SCH.PRE_FIXED_OT_END_TIME AS preFixedOtEndTime , SCH.FIXED_OT_STR_TIME AS fixedOtStrTime , SCH.FIXED_OT_END_TIME AS fixedOtEndTime FROM TB_USER_WORK_PLAN WP INNER JOIN (
) SCH ON SCH.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND SCH.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND SCH.SCH_CD = WP.WORK_PLAN_CD AND SCH.APPLY_DATE = ( SELECT COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SE.APPLY_DATE <= WP.WORK_YMD THEN SE.APPLY_DATE END) , MIN(SE.APPLY_DATE) ) FROM ( SELECT M3.CMPNY_CD, M3.SITE_CD, M3.SCH_CD, M3.APPLY_DATE FROM TB_SCH_MGMT M3 UNION ALL SELECT H3.CMPNY_CD, H3.SITE_CD, H3.SCH_CD, H3.APPLY_DATE FROM TB_SCH_MGMT_HIST H3 ) SE WHERE SE.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND SE.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND SE.SCH_CD = WP.WORK_PLAN_CD ) WHERE WP.CMPNY_CD = #{prvCmpnyCd} AND WP.SITE_CD = #{targetSiteCd} AND WP.WORK_YMD BETWEEN #{periodStr} AND #{periodEnd} AND ( SCH.FIXED_OT_STR_TIME IS NOT NULL OR SCH.PRE_FIXED_OT_STR_TIME IS NOT NULL )

/* Subcon03Mapper.selectOtOnlySourceRows */ SELECT O.USER_CD AS userCd , CASE WHEN U.USER_CD IS NOT NULL THEN 'REGULAR' ELSE 'DAILY' END AS workerType , COALESCE(U.USER_NM, D.USER_NM) AS workerNm , 'OT_ONLY' AS rowType , O.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , 0 AS workSeq , NULL AS schNm , NULL AS schType , NULL AS planStrTime , NULL AS planEndTime , NULL AS planBrkMin , LEFT(MIN(CONCAT(O.ACTUAL_START_DATE, O.ACTUAL_START_TIME)), 8) AS checkInDate , RIGHT(MIN(CONCAT(O.ACTUAL_START_DATE, O.ACTUAL_START_TIME)), 4) AS checkInTime , LEFT(MAX(CASE WHEN O.ACTUAL_END_DATE IS NOT NULL AND O.ACTUAL_END_TIME IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(O.ACTUAL_END_DATE, O.ACTUAL_END_TIME) END), 8) AS checkOutDate , RIGHT(MAX(CASE WHEN O.ACTUAL_END_DATE IS NOT NULL AND O.ACTUAL_END_TIME IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(O.ACTUAL_END_DATE, O.ACTUAL_END_TIME) END), 4) AS checkOutTime , NULL AS attdStatusCd , SUM(IFNULL(O.WORK_MINUTES, 0)) AS otMinutes , NULL AS leaveNm , NULL AS leaveDays , NULL AS leaveMinutes , NULL AS leaveEndYmd
, MIN(O.NODE_CD) AS nodeCd FROM TB_USER_OVERTIME_MGMT O LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = O.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = O.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_DAILY_USER D ON D.CMPNY_CD = O.CMPNY_CD AND D.USER_CD = O.USER_CD WHERE O.CMPNY_CD = #{prvCmpnyCd} AND O.SITE_CD = #{targetSiteCd} AND O.WORK_YMD BETWEEN #{periodStr} AND #{periodEnd} AND O.DEL_YN = 'N' AND O.OT_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USER_ATTD_MGMT A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = O.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = O.SITE_CD AND A.USER_CD = O.USER_CD AND A.WORK_YMD = O.WORK_YMD AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' ) GROUP BY O.USER_CD, O.WORK_YMD, U.USER_CD, U.USER_NM, D.USER_NM ORDER BY O.USER_CD ASC, O.WORK_YMD ASC

/* Subcon03Mapper.selectLeaveOnlySourceRows */ SELECT L.USER_CD AS userCd , CASE WHEN U.USER_CD IS NOT NULL THEN 'REGULAR' ELSE 'DAILY' END AS workerType , COALESCE(U.USER_NM, D.USER_NM) AS workerNm , 'LEAVE_ONLY' AS rowType , L.START_DATE AS workYmd , 0 AS workSeq , NULL AS schNm , NULL AS schType , NULL AS planStrTime , NULL AS planEndTime , NULL AS planBrkMin , NULL AS checkInDate , NULL AS checkInTime , NULL AS checkOutDate , NULL AS checkOutTime , NULL AS attdStatusCd , 0 AS otMinutes , LEFT(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT T.LEAVE_NM ORDER BY T.LEAVE_NM SEPARATOR ','), 200) AS leaveNm , SUM(IFNULL(L.LEAVE_DAYS, 0)) AS leaveDays , SUM(IFNULL(L.LEAVE_MINUTES, 0)) AS leaveMinutes , MAX(L.END_DATE) AS leaveEndYmd

/* Subcon03Mapper.selectSnapshotDetail */ SELECT D.DETAIL_ID AS detailId , D.WORKER_SEQ AS workerSeq , D.WORKER_TYPE AS workerType , D.WORKER_NM AS workerNm , D.AFFIL_CMPNY_NM AS affilCmpnyNm , D.ROW_TYPE AS rowType , D.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , D.WORK_SEQ AS workSeq , D.SCH_NM AS schNm , D.SCH_TYPE AS schType , D.PLAN_STR_TIME AS planStrTime , D.PLAN_END_TIME AS planEndTime , D.PLAN_BRK_MIN AS planBrkMin , D.CHECK_IN_DATE AS checkInDate , D.CHECK_IN_TIME AS checkInTime , D.CHECK_OUT_DATE AS checkOutDate , D.CHECK_OUT_TIME AS checkOutTime , D.ATTD_STATUS_CD AS attdStatusCd , D.OT_MINUTES AS otMinutes , D.LEAVE_NM AS leaveNm , D.LEAVE_DAYS AS leaveDays , D.LEAVE_MINUTES AS leaveMinutes , D.LEAVE_END_YMD AS leaveEndYmd
, D.FIXED_OT_MINUTES AS fixedOtMinutes FROM TB_CMPNY_SHARE_SNAPSHOT_ATTD D WHERE D.SNAPSHOT_ID = #{snapshotId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CMPNY_SHARE_SNAPSHOT S WHERE S.SNAPSHOT_ID = D.SNAPSHOT_ID AND S.OWNER_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} ) ORDER BY D.WORK_YMD ASC, D.WORKER_SEQ ASC, D.WORK_SEQ ASC, D.DETAIL_ID ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

/* Subcon03Mapper.selectRiskSourceRows */ SELECT A.PROCESS_CD AS processCd , A.ASSESSMENT_CD AS assessmentCd , A.INIT_ASSESSOR_ID AS initAssessorId , A.REVAL_ASSESSOR_ID AS revalAssessorId , C.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS processNm , D.RISK_TYPE_NM AS riskTypeNm , CASE WHEN A.HAZARD_CD = 'self' THEN A.ASSESSMENT_DESC ELSE E.HAZARD_NM END AS hazardNm , A.ASSESSMENT_DESC AS assessmentDesc , B.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS assessmentStatusNm , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.INIT_ASSESSOR_ID, NULL) AS initAssessorNm , A.INIT_LIKELIHOOD_SCORE AS initLikelihood , A.INIT_SEVERITY_SCORE AS initSeverity , A.INIT_RISK_LV AS initRiskLv , A.INIT_DESC AS initDesc , DATE_FORMAT(A.INIT_ASSESS_DATE, '%Y%m%d') AS initAssessDate , A.INIT_FILE_MGMT_CD AS initFileMgmtCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.REVAL_ASSESSOR_ID, NULL) AS revalAssessorNm , A.REVAL_LIKELIHOOD_SCORE AS revalLikelihood , A.REVAL_SEVERITY_SCORE AS revalSeverity , A.REVAL_RISK_LV AS revalRiskLv , A.REVAL_DESC AS revalDesc , A.REVAL_DATE AS revalAssessDate , A.REVAL_FILE_MGMT_CD AS revalFileMgmtCd FROM TB_RISK_ASSESSMENT A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SYST_VAL_D B ON B.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS011' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.ASSESSMENT_STATUS = B.SYST_VAL_D_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D C ON C.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND C.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM002' AND A.PROCESS_CD = C.BAIM_VAL_D_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_RISK_TYPE D ON A.CMPNY_CD = D.CMPNY_CD AND A.RISK_TYPE_CD = D.RISK_TYPE_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_RISK_SITE_HAZARD E ON A.CMPNY_CD = E.CMPNY_CD AND A.RISK_TYPE_CD = E.RISK_TYPE_CD AND A.HAZARD_CD = E.HAZARD_CD WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{prvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{targetSiteCd} AND A.ASSESSMENT_STATUS IN #{st} AND DATE(A.INIT_ASSESS_DATE) BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{periodStr}, '%Y%m%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{periodEnd}, '%Y%m%d') ORDER BY A.INIT_ASSESSOR_ID ASC, A.PROCESS_CD ASC, A.ASSESSMENT_CD ASC

/* Subcon03Mapper.selectRiskImproveSourceRows */ SELECT I.PROCESS_CD AS processCd , I.ASSESSMENT_CD AS assessmentCd , I.IMPROVEMENT_SEQ AS improveSeq , I.IMPROVE_DATE AS improveDate , I.IMPROVE_DESC AS improveDesc , I.LIKELIHOOD_SCORE AS likelihood , I.SEVERITY_SCORE AS severity , I.RISK_LV AS riskLv , I.FILE_MGMT_CD AS fileMgmtCd FROM TB_RISK_IMPROVEMENT_ITEM I WHERE I.CMPNY_CD = #{prvCmpnyCd} AND I.SITE_CD = #{targetSiteCd} AND I.USE_YN = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_RISK_ASSESSMENT A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = I.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = I.SITE_CD AND A.PROCESS_CD = I.PROCESS_CD AND A.ASSESSMENT_CD = I.ASSESSMENT_CD AND A.ASSESSMENT_STATUS IN #{st} AND DATE(A.INIT_ASSESS_DATE) BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{periodStr}, '%Y%m%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{periodEnd}, '%Y%m%d') ) ORDER BY I.PROCESS_CD ASC, I.ASSESSMENT_CD ASC, I.IMPROVEMENT_SEQ ASC

/* Subcon03Mapper.selectNearmissSourceRows */ SELECT A.REPORTER_ID AS reporterId , A.NEAR_MISS_ID AS nearMissId , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.REPORTER_ID, NULL) AS reporterNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.OCCUR_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS occurDtime , C.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS processNm , A.LOCATION_DESC AS locationDesc , A.DESCRIPTION AS description , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', A.POTENTIAL_SEVERITY_CD, 'SYS062') AS potentialSeverityNm , A.IMMEDIATE_ACTION_DESC AS immediateActionDesc , A.ADMIN_TEMP_ACTION_DESC AS adminTempActionDesc , A.CAUSE_DESC AS causeDesc , A.PREVENTION_DESC AS preventionDesc , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', A.REPORT_STATUS_CD, 'SYS063') AS reportStatusNm , A.FILE_MGMT_CD AS fileMgmtCd FROM TB_NEAR_MISS A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D C ON A.CMPNY_CD = C.CMPNY_CD AND C.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM002' AND A.PROCESS_CD = C.BAIM_VAL_D_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{prvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{targetSiteCd} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.REPORT_STATUS_CD IN #{st} AND A.OCCUR_DTIME >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{periodStr}, '000000'), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AND A.OCCUR_DTIME <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{periodEnd}, '235959'), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') ORDER BY A.REPORTER_ID ASC, A.OCCUR_DTIME ASC, A.NEAR_MISS_ID ASC

/* Subcon03Mapper.selectSnapshotRiskRows */ SELECT R.DETAIL_ID AS detailId , R.ROW_SEQ AS rowSeq , R.ASSESSOR_SEQ AS assessorSeq , R.AFFIL_CMPNY_NM AS affilCmpnyNm , R.PROCESS_NM AS processNm , R.RISK_TYPE_NM AS riskTypeNm , R.HAZARD_NM AS hazardNm , R.ASSESSMENT_DESC AS assessmentDesc , R.ASSESSMENT_STATUS_NM AS assessmentStatusNm , R.INIT_ASSESSOR_NM AS initAssessorNm , R.INIT_LIKELIHOOD AS initLikelihood , R.INIT_SEVERITY AS initSeverity , R.INIT_RISK_LV AS initRiskLv , R.INIT_DESC AS initDesc , R.INIT_ASSESS_DATE AS initAssessDate , R.INIT_FILE_MGMT_CD AS initFileMgmtCd , R.REVAL_ASSESSOR_NM AS revalAssessorNm , R.REVAL_LIKELIHOOD AS revalLikelihood , R.REVAL_SEVERITY AS revalSeverity , R.REVAL_RISK_LV AS revalRiskLv , R.REVAL_DESC AS revalDesc , R.REVAL_ASSESS_DATE AS revalAssessDate , R.REVAL_FILE_MGMT_CD AS revalFileMgmtCd FROM TB_CMPNY_SHARE_SNAPSHOT_RISK R WHERE R.SNAPSHOT_ID = #{snapshotId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CMPNY_SHARE_SNAPSHOT S WHERE S.SNAPSHOT_ID = R.SNAPSHOT_ID AND S.OWNER_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} ) ORDER BY R.ROW_SEQ ASC, R.DETAIL_ID ASC

/* Subcon03Mapper.selectSnapshotRiskImproveRows */ SELECT I.IMPROVE_ID AS improveId , I.DETAIL_ID AS detailId , I.IMPROVE_SEQ AS improveSeq , I.IMPROVE_DATE AS improveDate , I.IMPROVE_DESC AS improveDesc , I.LIKELIHOOD AS likelihood , I.SEVERITY AS severity , I.RISK_LV AS riskLv , I.FILE_MGMT_CD AS fileMgmtCd FROM TB_CMPNY_SHARE_SNAPSHOT_RISK_IMPROVE I WHERE I.SNAPSHOT_ID = #{snapshotId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CMPNY_SHARE_SNAPSHOT S WHERE S.SNAPSHOT_ID = I.SNAPSHOT_ID AND S.OWNER_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} ) ORDER BY I.DETAIL_ID ASC, I.IMPROVE_SEQ ASC

/* Subcon03Mapper.selectSnapshotNearmissRows */ SELECT N.DETAIL_ID AS detailId , N.ROW_SEQ AS rowSeq , N.REPORTER_SEQ AS reporterSeq , N.AFFIL_CMPNY_NM AS affilCmpnyNm , N.REPORTER_NM AS reporterNm , DATE_FORMAT(N.OCCUR_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS occurDtime , N.PROCESS_NM AS processNm , N.LOCATION_DESC AS locationDesc , N.DESCRIPTION AS description , N.POTENTIAL_SEVERITY_NM AS potentialSeverityNm , N.IMMEDIATE_ACTION_DESC AS immediateActionDesc , N.ADMIN_TEMP_ACTION_DESC AS adminTempActionDesc , N.CAUSE_DESC AS causeDesc , N.PREVENTION_DESC AS preventionDesc , N.REPORT_STATUS_NM AS reportStatusNm , N.FILE_MGMT_CD AS fileMgmtCd FROM TB_CMPNY_SHARE_SNAPSHOT_NEARMISS N WHERE N.SNAPSHOT_ID = #{snapshotId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CMPNY_SHARE_SNAPSHOT S WHERE S.SNAPSHOT_ID = N.SNAPSHOT_ID AND S.OWNER_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} ) ORDER BY N.ROW_SEQ ASC, N.DETAIL_ID ASC
